name: Wealth taxes for a quarter of a year: thresholds on the balance, the tax pro rata
workings: The year's balances are held for a quarter of the year (a plan's first year after a check-in on 30 September is 92/365; 0.25 here)
Current account: the balance 10,000.00 is above 5,000, so the bollo is due: 34.20 × 0.25 = 8.55 (testing a quarter of the balance, 2,500.00, would wrongly find none)
